meta.name: remix-imessage-ad-from-sample
meta.description: Remix a published iMessage video ad from the Goose Ads library for a new brand — keep the source's conversation structure and pacing, swap in the brand's product, voice, and promo code, get the thread approved in-session, then render with create-imessage-video-ad and publish the MP4 back to Gooseworks with live stage reporting. The video counterpart to remix-graphic-ad-from-reference; this is what the app's iMessage format tab calls.
